intro.title: One good photo.
intro.body: Every hold you set lives on it, so it pays to get the shot right.

good.title: The shot that works
tips: Stand square on to the wall
Tilt it to match the wall's angle
good.result: Every hold the same size and shape

landscape.title: Not landscape
landscape.body: You climb with the phone upright. A landscape photo shrinks to a strip and the holds get too small to tap.

side.title: Not from the side
side.body: Off to one side, the far holds shrink and bunch up.

upright.title: Not straight up and down
upright.body: Hold the phone upright under an overhang and the top looms while the bottom shrinks away.

why.title: Why it matters
why.body: Even light and clear contrast between holds and wall help the hold finder recognize them. Skewed holds look small and stretched, so more get missed.

start.title: Start from Boards
start.body: Tap Spray wall to make a wall from a photo.

name.title: Name it and set the angle
name.body: Choose who can see it before you continue.

photo.title: Choose your wall photo
photo.body: Use the square-on portrait shot with the whole wall in frame.

corners.title: Check the four corners
corners.body: Pin them for other backgrounds, or skip a square-on shot.

detect.title: Boardsesh finds the holds
detect.body: Use the hold editor to check its rings and mark anything it missed.

maybe.title: Keep the holds it nearly found
maybe.body: Select a dashed ring, then tap Keep.

resize.title: Adjust a selected ring
resize.body: Use the minus and plus controls below the wall.

add.title: Switch to Add for missed holds
add.body: Tap for a circle or draw an outline. The editor video below shows both.

background.title: Check the wall background
background.body: Photo is available when you skip pinning corners.

publish.title: Choose a hold look and publish
publish.body: Use Aura Outline to put the wall on your Boards.

open.title: Edit holds after publishing
open.body: Missed one? Open your wall on Climbs, then tap Edit holds.

switchOff.title: Hold came off? Switch it off
switchOff.body: Select its ring, then tap Switch off.

remove.title: Delete a switched-off hold
remove.body: Select the ghost ring and tap Delete.

add.title: Add a new hold
add.body: Switch to Add, then tap the wall or draw around it.

publish.title: Publish holds
publish.body: Publish when ready. The editor video below explains used-hold warnings.
